newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ SPORT-RUGBY UNION-Marshall Canterbury's player of the year.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT-RUGBY UNION-Marshall Canterbury's player of the year.

text.p: WELLINGTON, Oct 7 - All Black test halfback Justin Marshall was last night named Canterbury Rugby Supporters' Club player of the year, NZPA reported on Monday.
He played only six games for the province this year but has been the leading performer, as he was in Saturday's 43-20 win over North Harbour in the national provincial championship.
Marshall, who scored two tries in the match, was the All Blacks' most improved test player on the tour of South Africa this year.
